verdict.rationale: Azure documents scripted, non-interactive use. The Azure CLI supports scripts and runs in Docker containers, the REST API docs recommend curl for unattended DevOps automation scripts, and Bicep, ARM templates and Terraform provide declarative automated deployment. Managed identities let automation get tokens without managing credentials, and a community user notes almost everything can be done via the command line. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines tasks), documented non-interactive service-principal login for the CLI in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Azure CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources with interactive commands or scripts.
You might consider using curl in unattended scripts. For example, in DevOps automation scenarios.
It can also be run in a Docker container and Azure Cloud Shell.
Applications can use managed identities to obtain Microsoft Entra tokens without having to manage any credentials.
Almost everything can be done via command line.
